test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. 

Hockey : Fullback :: Cricket : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 
• Hockey : Fullback → In this a player in a defensive position or playing at the side of field of hockey and soccer called Fullback.

Similarly

 
• Cricket : Gully → The gully fielder is an extension of the line of slips and related to the cricket.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Gully".**
